en: Colorized vintage street view showing a quiet small-town scene with two‑story houses and shops along a curved road. A few pedestrians and a cyclist are visible. Trees line the street, fences border the sidewalks, and the sky is tinted in soft blue and orange. At the top, printed text identifies the location as Großbröhrsdorf and Bischofswerdaer Straße. On the right façade a shop sign reads "E. Emil Bock".
